nodes.name: Freehub Ratcheting Mechanism
nodes.description: Internal ratcheting mechanism contained within a freehub that allows cassette freewheeling when pedals are stationary.

freewheel_function.name: Freewheel Operation
freewheel_function.note: Contains ratcheting mechanism to allow cassette freewheeling

evidence.quote:
Hubs designed with a freehub contain a ratcheting mechanism to allow
cassette freewheeling.

nodes.name: Freehub Cartridge Bearing
nodes.description: Cartridge bearings pressed into the freehub body to support rotational loads between the hub axle and cassette.

bearing_type.name: Bearing Construction
bearing_type.note: Cartridge bearings inside freehub pressed in evenly

evidence.quote: The hub design may include cartridge bearings inside the freehub.

nodes.name: Crankset 50mm Chainline Specification
nodes.description: Design chainline standard where the middle of the front chainrings is positioned 50mm from the bicycle center plane for optimal front derailleur operation.

target_distance.name: Chainline Distance
target_distance.note: Middle of chainrings 50mm from bike centerline

evidence.quote:
As an example, a
front crankset and/or front derailleur might be designed to have a chainline
of 50mm. The front derailleur would then work best when the middle of the
chainrings are 50mm from the bike centerline.

nodes.name: Rear Derailleur Shift Wire
nodes.description: Shift wire plugged into the rear derailleur body and secured by a pinch screw.

retention.name: Wire Retention Mechanism
retention.note: Shift wire plugs into body and is held in by pinch screw

evidence.quote:
The shift
wire plugs into the body, and is held in by a pinch screw (figure 11.27).
Always loosen this screw before attempting to pull the plug.

nodes.name: SRAM XD Integrated Cassette Lockring
nodes.description: Lockring integrated into the cassette body turned by a tool fitting at the small end of the cassette on SRAM XD/XDR systems.

tool_fitting.name: Tool Interface
tool_fitting.note: Turned by tool fitting at small end using FR-5 series tools

evidence.quote:
removable lockring at the outer end of the freehub. Instead, a lockring is
integrated into the cassette body and is turned by the tool fitting at the small
end of the cassette (figure 3.8). SRAM® XD™ and XDR™ compatible
cassettes use the Park Tool FR-5 series of lockring tools.

nodes.name: Roller Chain Pin-to-Pin Pitch (unconfirmed)
nodes.description: Estimated ~0.5 inch (12.7 mm) roller chain pin-to-pin pitch from visual diagram analysis.

estimated_pitch.name: Estimated Pin-to-Pin Distance
estimated_pitch.note: Pin-to-pin distance appears to be ~0.5 inch (12.7 mm)

evidence.quote: Pin-to-pin distance appears to be ~0.5 inch (12.7 mm).

nodes.name: XDR Cassette Body Bearing Dimensions (unconfirmed)
nodes.description: Visually estimated 15mm ID x 28mm OD bearing dimension for XDR cassette body from repair diagram inspection.

estimated_dimensions.name: Estimated Dimensions
estimated_dimensions.note: Visually identified with dimensions approximately 15mm ID x 28mm OD

evidence.quote: The cassette body contains a bearing (visually identified with dimensions approximately 15mm ID x 28mm OD), with a stainless steel race.
